title: Black Bean Tofu Tacos
cScaleSummary: Low-cholesterol plant-based taco filling with tofu, black beans, and a small amount of olive oil.
ldlActiveSummary: Cholesterol-free, low in saturated fat, and high in fiber from black beans.
intro: A nostalgic, old-school crunchy taco filling made with crumbled tofu, black beans, tomato paste, and classic taco-night spices.
miseEnPlace: Prepare {{ingredient:extra-firm-tofu}} as specified: drained and pressed.

stepGroups.title: Instructions
items: Wrap {{ingredient:extra-firm-tofu}} in a clean towel and press for 10 to 15 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Crumble the tofu into small, uneven pieces about the size of cooked ground taco meat.
Heat {{ingredient:olive-oil}} in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion ({{quantity:yellow-onion}}) and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened.
Add the garlic ({{quantity:garlic}}) and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tofu loses moisture and begins to brown in spots.
Add the black beans ({{quantity:black-beans}}) and lightly mash about half of the beans into the tofu mixture.

Stir in the chili powder ({{quantity:chili-powder}}), ground cumin ({{quantity:ground-cumin}}), paprika ({{quantity:paprika}}), dried oregano ({{quantity:dried-oregano}}), kosher salt ({{quantity:kosher-salt}}), and black pepper ({{quantity:black-pepper}}), and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste ({{quantity:tomato-paste}}) and low-sodium soy sauce ({{quantity:low-sodium-soy-sauce}}) until the tofu and beans are evenly coated.
Add the low-sodium vegetable broth ({{quantity:low-sodium-vegetable-broth}}) and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the filling is moist, thick, and scoopable.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the apple cider vinegar ({{quantity:apple-cider-vinegar}}).
Let the taco filling rest for 5 minutes before spooning into crunchy taco shells.
